summary.text: Shane Morigeau is a Democratic member of the Montana State Senate representing District 50 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, he previously served in the Montana House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Shane Morigeau was born in Ronan, Montana, and lives in Missoula.

He earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Montana School of Forestry and Conservation in 2007, a J.D. from the University of Montana School of Law in 2010, and a master of laws from the University of Arizona in 2011.
His career experience includes working as a prosecutor and attorney with the Confederated Salish and Kootenai Tribes.
Morigeau served in the Montana House of Representatives, District 95, from 2017 to 2020.
In the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Finance and Claims, Fish and Game, and Natural Resources committees, with a vice chair role on Natural Resources.
